% Parallel / perpendicular current decomposition
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C2_decomp}
\mathbf{J} = \mathbf{J}_{\|} + \mathbf{J}_{\perp},\quad \mathbf{J}_{\|} = (\mathbf{J}\cdot\hat{\mathbf{B}})\hat{\mathbf{B}},\quad \mathbf{J}_{\perp} = \mathbf{J} - \mathbf{J}_{\|}
\end{equation}

% Lorentz selectivity
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C2_selective}
\mathbf{J}_{\|} \times \mathbf{B} = \mathbf{0},\quad \text{so only } \mathbf{J}_{\perp} \text{ experiences Lorentz force.}
\end{equation}

% Ambipolar electric field
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C2_Eamb}
\mathbf{E}_{\mathrm{amb}} = \eta_A (\mathbf{J}\times\hat{\mathbf{B}})\times\hat{\mathbf{B}} = -\eta_A\,\mathbf{J}_{\perp}
\end{equation}

% Alternative form (avoids unit vectors — kernel-friendly)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C2_altform}
(\mathbf{J}\times\hat{\mathbf{B}})\times\hat{\mathbf{B}} = \frac{(\mathbf{J}\times\mathbf{B})\times\mathbf{B}}{|\mathbf{B}|^{2}}\quad \text{(preferred form for kernels — no } 1/\hat{B}\text{ normalisation)}
\end{equation}

% Induction equation with ambipolar diffusion
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C2_induction}
\partial_t \mathbf{B} = \nabla\times(\mathbf{v}\times\mathbf{B}) + \nabla\times\!\left[\eta_A\,\frac{(\mathbf{J}\times\mathbf{B})\times\mathbf{B}}{|\mathbf{B}|^{2}}\right]
\end{equation}

% Ambipolar heating (positive-definite)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C2_Qamb}
Q_{\mathrm{amb}} = -\mathbf{E}_{\mathrm{amb}}\cdot\mathbf{J} = \eta_A\,|\mathbf{J}_{\perp}|^{2} \ge 0
\end{equation}

% Ambipolar explicit-diffusion CFL
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C2_CFL}
\Delta t \le \frac{(\Delta x)^{2}}{2\,\eta_A\,|\mathbf{B}|^{2}/\rho}\qquad\text{(per direction, 2nd-order centred)}
\end{equation}
